description: This file defines the TestDB package, a Perl module that extends a test database class, providing methods for initializing test data, executing SQL scripts, and performing install and upgrade tests within a testing framework.

classes.name: TestDB
classes.description: A Perl package extending a test database class with methods for initializing test data and performing database schema operations.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Initializes a new test database schema, optionally loading test data from a SQL file.

methods.name: execute_test_data
methods.description: Executes SQL statements from a specified file to populate the test database.

methods.name: install_ok
methods.description: Performs an installation test of the database schema, optionally specifying a version and test name.

methods.name: upgrade_ok
methods.description: Performs an upgrade test of the database schema to a specified version, optionally with a test name.
